title: Impact report assembly
responsibility: Turns kernel reachability into affected units, tests and scenarios, widening selection when changes cannot be safely bounded.

inputs.name: graphTests.graph
inputs.description: Source graph whose test nodes should be extracted.

inputs.name: impactReport.input
inputs.description: Base/head snapshots, classified change seeds and kernel output to combine into a report.

outputs.name: graphTests
outputs.description: Paths of graph nodes marked test and matching a supported .test or .spec JavaScript/TypeScript filename.

outputs.name: impactReport
outputs.description: Report fields excluding base/head/runtime: changed files, direct/indirect/added/removed units, selected/excluded/removed tests, affected/unaffected scenarios and deduplicated uncertainty. Global, unclassified or uncovered source changes select all current tests and scenarios.
